lag.evidence_source: [020_22_participants] Mean age at Wave 1 was 14.86 years (standard deviation [SD] = 0.64). ... We used Wave 12 data to study young adult outcomes when the participants were in their mid-30s (mean age was 34.09 years, SD = 0.62). Waves 1 through 4 correspond to the participants' high school years. (Calculation: Age difference 34.09 - 14.86 = 19.23 years over 11 intervals (W1 to W12). If W1-W4 are annual (3 intervals of 1 year), then 3 years pass. Age at W4 = 14.86 + 3 = 17.86. Remaining 19.23 - 3 = 16.23 years over 8 intervals (W4 to W12). Average interval for W4-W12 = 16.23 / 8 = 2.02875 years. The modal interval is 2.0 years.)
